🚨| Former Barça Atlètic coach Gerard López testified in the Negreira case today, confirming that he received refereeing reports prepared by Negreira and his son between 2015 and 2018.

He described the reports as VERY USEFUL for preparing matches, explaining that they helped his coaching staff understand referees’ tendencies, including their approach to issuing yellow cards and communicating with players.

He also pointed out that referees in the lower divisions were relatively unknown and that every team used to access such information to improve their match preparation. [@sport via @forca_fcb] #fcblive

🚨 | 𝐎𝐅𝐅𝐈𝐂𝐈𝐀𝐋: Barça have officially finalised a €300M financing operation to complete the remaining construction work at Spotify Camp Nou, following approval from Spain’s National Securities Market Commission (CNMV). Goldman Sachs acted as the sole placement agent.
The funding forms part of the €510 million financing package approved by club members in September and will support the stadium’s transformation into Europe's largest-capacity football venue, featuring expanded VIP areas, premium hospitality facilities and modern infrastructure. The financing will be repaid through future stadium-generated revenues, with the objective of completing the Espai Barça project and strengthening the club’s long-term financial position. #fcblive
